summary: This Form 6-K reports CN Energy Group's entry into a Mutual Settlement Agreement with former CEO Steven Berman on June 3, 2026. The agreement resolves disputes including Berman's service, internal investigation, and asset sale matters, with a $25,000 settlement paid to his counsel and acknowledgment of $277,000 in paid leave. Berman resigned from all positions effective June 3, 2026. The agreement includes mutual releases, confidentiality, and non-disparagement clauses. As a foreign private issuer, this filing is analogous to a U.S. Form 8-K Item 5.02. What to watch: potential leadership stability and any related strategic shifts.
